mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1200K units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4.5%, signaling a tight labor market, wage pressures increase, leading to higher production costs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average, indicating supply chain resilience, boosts market sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The joint behavior of rising housing starts (HOUST) and increasing retail sales (RSAFS) signals broad-based demand strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are rising.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase above 2% in a single month, signaling a rapid monetary tightening, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS surges above 2% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in payroll employment (PAYEMS) exceeds 2.5%, signaling robust labor market growth, the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during non-recessionary regimes.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of non-recessionary instances when PAYEMS YoY growth exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of a GDP growth rate (GDPC1) above 3% and a low unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% creates a virtuous cycle of demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window when both conditions are met.
